stemMd: A circle has circumference 14π. What is its area?
explanationMd: From 2πr=14π, the radius is 7. Area is πr squared=49π. Keep the radius distinct from the diameter 14.

distractorRationale.e: This repeats the circumference rather than finding area.
distractorRationale.d: This adds an extra factor of two.
distractorRationale.a: This multiplies radius by π without squaring.
